refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: How refunds work and how to withdraw from your wallet

overview.title: Refund overview
overview.content: We're committed to giving you a great service experience. If you're not satisfied with a purchase, you can request a refund under our refund policy. Refunds are returned to your account as wallet balance.

refundProcess.title: Refund process
refundProcess.content: Once your refund request is approved, the amount is immediately credited to your account wallet balance. You can use the wallet balance to keep buying our service, or request a withdrawal to your crypto wallet address.

walletBalance.title: About wallet balance
walletBalance.content: Your wallet balance is a virtual account balance on the 开途 Kaitu platform and can be used to: 1. Buy or renew any plan; 2. Withdraw to a supported crypto wallet. Refunds to your wallet are available immediately — no waiting.

withdrawalMethods.title: Withdrawal methods
withdrawalMethods.content: You can withdraw your wallet balance to major crypto wallets. Supported cryptocurrencies include:

supportedCryptos.title: Supported cryptocurrencies
supportedCryptos.other: Other major stablecoins and cryptocurrencies (please check with support)

withdrawalProcess.title: Withdrawal process
withdrawalProcess.step1: 1. Request a withdrawal on your account page
withdrawalProcess.step2: 2. Choose the cryptocurrency and blockchain network
withdrawalProcess.step4: 4. Confirm the withdrawal amount and fee
withdrawalProcess.step5: 5. Submit the request and wait for review
withdrawalProcess.step6: 6. Funds arrive within 1-3 business days after approval

importantNotes.title: Important notes
importantNotes.note1: • Make absolutely sure the wallet address and blockchain network you provide are correct
importantNotes.note2: • Any loss of funds caused by an incorrect wallet address is the user's responsibility
importantNotes.note3: • Withdrawal fees may differ by cryptocurrency and network
importantNotes.note4: • Withdrawal requests can't be cancelled once submitted, so please be careful
importantNotes.note5: • Your first withdrawal may require identity verification
importantNotes.note6: • Large withdrawals may require an additional security review

withdrawalFees.title: Withdrawal fees
withdrawalFees.content: Withdrawal fees vary by cryptocurrency and blockchain network. The exact fee is shown when you request a withdrawal. We try to process withdrawals on lower-fee networks whenever possible.

processingTime.title: Processing time
processingTime.content: Withdrawal requests are processed within 1-3 business days. The exact arrival time depends on the blockchain network's confirmation speed and may take longer during peak times or network congestion.

refundPolicy.title: Refund eligibility
refundPolicy.content: Refund requests must meet the following conditions: no more than 7 days of service, no heavy data usage, account in good standing, etc. For full refund conditions, see the Terms of Service or contact support.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.content: If you have any questions about refunds or withdrawals, feel free to contact our support team: support@kaitu.io
